nodes.label: project_contract
nodes.rationale: Before modifying project content read README, structure and workflow. Final reorganization agreements override older conflicts. Preserve scientific inputs, researcher edits, missingness and diagnostic restrictions; serialize central workbook writes.

nodes.label: Canonical bounded knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: tools/knowledge_graph/graph.json is the only current graph location. Its scope states snapshot coverage and freshness; retrieval is not evidence of current scientific results.

nodes.label: catalog.json.gz
nodes.rationale: Exact historical const DB JSON with source context and alternative-model evidence; supports adapter, not current result/selection authority.

nodes.label: time_series.json.gz
nodes.rationale: Exact historical const SERIES_DB JSON. Embedded strings and numeric values preserved; old shells and paths are not runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: SourcePaths.resolve historical provenance
nodes.rationale: Resolve retained sources through portable source_paths.csv; intentional removal returns None and is omitted from links. Keep frozen historical provenance strings without obsolete folder dependencies.

nodes.label: Historical payload numerical parity check
nodes.rationale: Current adapter integrity/source membership and JavaScript map/time-series calculations compared with retained payloads; historical HTML unnecessary.

nodes.label: Shared original monthly NPP rasters
nodes.rationale: One global collection avoids distributing overlap copies. 1,104 monthly files (288 Copernicus NetCDF,816 VGPM/Eppley/CBPM/CAFE compressed HDF) and six boundaries use Git LFS; pointers fail full-byte verification.

nodes.label: NPP source_manifest.json
nodes.rationale: Portable paths/sizes/SHA-256/monthly URLs record verified originals. September source audits and current reorganization verification are separate evidence.

nodes.label: Explicit adoption of new NPP output
nodes.rationale: New extraction does not replace reviewed workbook series automatically. Preserve algorithm membership/availability/gap-fill/provenance; adopted-run config/code/source hashes are versioned evidence, then dependent ratios/refresh update.
nodes.norm_label: explicit adoption of new npp output

nodes.label: Historical September NPP extraction study
nodes.rationale: Retained research/npp_extraction_2026_09 contains historical outputs/helper execution evidence; current entry point is tools/cli/npp.py plan/run, not archived expansion helper.

nodes.label: ModelData and PPRCalculator User Guide
nodes.rationale: Current complete authoritative ModelData/PPRCalculator scientific/API explainer; plan records removal of its stale engine-directory duplicate in favor of a pointer. Current structure, parameters and actual model-specific provenance govern execution; toy/legacy, global and MC examples do not confer authorization or scientific readiness.

nodes.label: ModelData
nodes.rationale: Loads supported canonical JSON or legacy integer input, exposes raw groups/DC/det_fate/name maps and injects diet_import. Canonical directory/explicit metadata resolve known identity; unknown number/year stays unknown. Engine reference/toy inputs are distinct from regional candidates.

nodes.label: PPRCalculator
nodes.rationale: Constructs from path, ModelData or toy attribute dictionary. Explicit normalization/tolerance/eligible BA-offset options apply to ephemeral runtime. Per-group LIM updates final predation/routing and derived ratios without coupled food-web reconstruction; failed optimization keeps cells missing then inherited fallbacks apply. Completion does not guarantee balance; balanced_model is separate.

nodes.label: SPPR_EwE_Ulanowicz equivalence claim
nodes.rationale: Current guide limits simple-path versus cycle-pruned nullspace equivalence to acyclic webs with compatible efficiency/options and complete path enumeration. nodes.label: Specific Primary Production Required
nodes.rationale: Basal-source production per group-production unit; catch times coefficient gives ecological catch requirement. Trophic-level and topology-aware flow-network methods differ.

nodes.label: Basal and consumer trophic categories

nodes.label: Transfer efficiency conventions
nodes.rationale: GE=p/q; TE=GE*EE; With Egestion=p/(q-egestion); global scalar. Consumer-weighted arithmetic means retain TE0 consumers and total Q weighting, with model-catch to biomass fallback, not annual regional catch weights.

nodes.label: Diet-derived trophic levels
nodes.rationale: TL=(I-DC)^-1*1; basal rows TL1, optional cycle removal/detritus provenance conventions change results. JSON-initialized TL need not match publication.

nodes.label: Living-network nullspace source basis
nodes.rationale: A=DC/efficiency with terminal identity rows; normalized nullspace columns anchor source units. Living cyclic path-series interpretation requires convergence, not merely finite inversion.

nodes.label: SPPR_1986
nodes.rationale: Fixed TE .1 with single catch-weighted mean TL yields same coefficient every group; no catch returns zeros.

nodes.label: SPPR_1995
nodes.rationale: Each group's continuous TL uses uniform global TE; consumer weighted mean is an alternative to fixed .1.

nodes.label: SPPR_1995_TL_fix
nodes.rationale: Linear mixture of bracketing integer TL chain costs: at positive TE the direct fractional exponential lies below the straight-line interpolation and agrees at integers. The authoritative guide now states the same direction. Adopted discrete mixture does not establish an observed diet allocation.

nodes.label: SPPR_EwE simple paths
nodes.rationale: Enumerates simple paths retaining diet weights, optionally scales focal row by EE. Repeated cycles are omitted and can undercount true cycle sum; return_paths controls path evidence.

nodes.label: SPPR_EwE_Ulanowicz cycle-pruned nullspace
nodes.rationale: Weakest-link cycle removal zeros edges without renormalizing survivors. Equivalent to simple paths only when acyclic; otherwise neither is exact all-cycle sum.

nodes.label: SPPR_2015 Leontief method
nodes.rationale: Dissolve detritus PP-derived ancestry onto producers; production-normalized Leontief inversion counts cycles subject to spectral radius<1. Returns SPPR,A,L.

nodes.label: SPPR_new
nodes.rationale: Primary numeric nullspace solver keeps cycles and explicit separate detritus pools; GE/With Egestion recycling versus TE ancestry. Executable detritus branch rejects global despite get_TE support.

nodes.label: Coupled detritus recycling system
nodes.rationale: Single-pool x=a/(1-b), multi-pool (I-B)x=c. Basis comes from living network; mortality carries group cost and With Egestion credits egested prey cost via DC transpose, not consumer production cost.

nodes.label: Detritus openness and pooling settings
nodes.rationale: never solves coupled system even unstable; auto/always pool as explicit approximations without validity guarantee. recycling_loss damps B only; source_dilution damps B and substitutes c with external cost; none leaves loop unchanged.

nodes.label: Single-detritus TE EE-zero re-credit
nodes.rationale: fix_EE_0_cases re-credits consumed basal burden at exactly zero EE in single-pool TE, not input repair or near-positive EE/multi-pool fix. Symbolic correction only as_PP TE branch.

nodes.label: SPPR_symbolic
nodes.rationale: Symbolic steady-state solve with detritus knobs. as_DC prices imported diet through non-import prey-weighted costs; as_PP anchors import cost1 and changes accounting.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo TE uncertainty
nodes.rationale: Gamma positive-TE resampling and clipping propagate nonlinear uncertainty; nonpositive efficiencies stay fixed. Negative samples reject; optional divergence grade screening catches positive but diverged returns. All rejected yields missing mean. API1000 versus exporter100 draws is separate scope.

nodes.label: diagnose_sppr
nodes.rationale: One internal SPPR_new solve grades configuration-specific model_input/divergence/balance; worst grade is overall. Footprint is reported but ungraded. return_sppr reuses solved matrix, avoiding duplicate calculation.

nodes.label: Living-network convergence rho_living
nodes.rationale: rho(A_LL)<1 is required; failure corrupts living basis and invalidates derived detritus gain b. This condition is not additive/interchangeable with pool convergence.

nodes.label: Detritus recycling convergence b
nodes.rationale: b=rho(B-open)<1 required but approaching1 can inflate costs despite passing convergence. Measured before pooling; pool SPPR magnitude and source-level negatives retain separate warnings/failures.

nodes.label: Primary-production budget closure
nodes.rationale: Inflow NPP plus diet import is compared with catch/growth/net-migration SPPR-weighted outflow. Relative gap is distinct from input balance and convergence.

nodes.label: Catch-weighted ecosystem PPR
nodes.rationale: Sum catch*SPPR per source; get_PPR returns one-row DataFrame. only_inner drops Import; only_pp drops Import and DET. Ratio uses inner PPR/PP production.

nodes.label: Net migration production outflow
nodes.rationale: Nm is emigration−immigration in ModelData, with calculator detritus import subtracted. Positive Nm is an outflow; production p=BA+predation+catch+Nm+M0, not biomass gain.

nodes.label: Post-solve all inner PP scopes

Equal incoming/outgoing circulation removal preserves external balance. Overlapping cycles make result order-dependent; this is not claimed EwE-equivalent, a nexus algorithm or biological simulation, and does not overwrite/rebalance saved model.

nodes.rationale: One requested-option execution retains full returns and coefficients, every supplied matrix with ordered row/column IDs/names/orientation/units/scopes/synthetic flags and distinct null/NaN/±infinity masks. Scalar methods explicitly lack decomposition. Save effective settings/constructor/runtime/code/environment/time/grades/flags/rho/detritus/b definition. Negative-entry convenience table does not replace matrix; reopen and reconcile scope sums/coefficient/summary within stated tolerances.
nodes.norm_label: lossless diagnostic matrices masks and axes

nodes.label: Review-to-adoption numerical and display reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Record membership/allocation/overall confidence separately, assumed flags, prior/adopted decisions and exact observed/proxy catch values including zero candidates. Unadopted report changes require keyed discrepancy ledger. Authorized adoption retains valid unchanged group SPPR, refreshes dependent regional outputs, Project/map/trends/source pages and visible remembered controls; Word/Excel derive from same adopted rows. Until aligned and verified, pending-alignment draft. Preserve researcher originals/manual SPPR OOXML and file exclusions.

nodes.label: Three-column Taxonomy workbook contract
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy.xlsx one sheet rows by seq, exact columns seq,group_name,taxon_descr. database_json.py indexes second and reads LAST column, so no fourth column. JSON-only EcoBase may retain taxonomy.csv with every exact group under extracted_tables/evidence, no invented eight-file extraction. Apply taxon_descr only in authorized variant preserving numerics/hash; JSON-only taxonomy does not imply SPPR or annual run.

nodes.label: Source table purpose and membership precedence
nodes.rationale: Distinguish exhaustive composition, representative members, catch allocation and diet-study lists. Diet-study absence neither excludes taxon nor resolves geographic/stage weights. Bay A3.1 diet sources differ from A1.1 catch and A1.3 composition. members.csv authoritative mapping semantics have no table-scope precedence, so reconcile before adoption. Keep assumed Very low mappings out of source taxon_descr; use explicit not documented for checked gaps.
nodes.norm_label: source table purpose and membership precedence

nodes.label: Model profile geography stage and spatial prefixes
nodes.rationale: MODEL_PROFILE records group axis, prefixes, source area/time, harvest-eligible pools/single stocks and membership extent. Okhotsk NE variant is whole Sea, not northeastern; spatial prefixes prevent defaulting whole-region catch into one stratum. Source boundary must not be inferred from filename.
nodes.norm_label: model profile geography stage and spatial prefixes

nodes.label: Verified residual fisheries reporting scopes
nodes.rationale: Assess every exact provider label, historical rank bridge, operative max-size/length/depth/stage definitions and all candidates. Scaridae familyAphia125557→Scarinae differs from misspelled genus398089→Calotomus. Elasmobranchii excludes chimaeras. SAU100039/139/239/339 bridge ISSCAAP39 bony fish, distinct fromcartilaginous38; mixed guilds remain through actual eligible bony members. Named categories do not automatically exclude residual membership; functional tags are not exhaustive boundaries. Cephalopod broad/narrow reporting unions and WCPO fish/squid deep guilds need actual version evidence.

nodes.label: Missing Ecopath source recovery
nodes.rationale: Within authorized discovery, identify exact DOI/source/model years, inspect local attachments/native data then publisher attachments, official repositories/APIs, author archives, explicit predecessor lineage, EcoBase/native separate variant. Legitimate public/authorized access only; no bypass/purchase/contact without authorization. Distinguish searched-not-found, identified inaccessible, downloaded incomplete and verified.

nodes.label: Recovered attachment integrity and lineage checks
nodes.rationale: Verify actual file type, complete bytes/pages/ranges/title, URL/date/name/hash/checksum and table geometry. HTML challenge is not PDF; flattened missing-cell text cannot recover positions. Predecessor reuse needs explicit lineage and group/parameter/period/area/diet/catch/stage crosswalk and no double area conversion. Dynamic endpoints require realized diet/flows/BA/state precision; baseline diets cannot be silently reused.
nodes.norm_label: recovered attachment integrity and lineage checks

nodes.label: Bounded recovery and missing-prerequisite NOT_RUN
nodes.rationale: New supplements reopen blocked stages while earlier missing-source reports stay dated history. After relevant repositories/predecessors checked, retain search outcomes and missing inputs, avoid repeated identical failures, continue faithful extraction and mark absent-prerequisite calculations NOT_RUN. Budget residual does not recover diet/fate/catch/biomass/version; proposed assumption variant remains separate.

nodes.label: Canonical model preparation and selection workflow
nodes.rationale: Maintained extraction procedure/resources and reconstruction audit govern exact groups/layouts/roundtrip/mass-balance/source unknowns. Source papers/supplements/context have explicit source_manifest roles; every distinct model is registered separately. Sole exact canonical model.json beside model_notes, latest eight import tables under extracted_tables; writer/conversion intermediates temporary. JSON-only EcoBase uses regional ecobase, separate numerical variant until compared. Published companions retain extra fields without altering eight import schemas.

nodes.label: Canonical diet and runtime normalization separation
nodes.rationale: Printed/native prey/import cells and explicitly accepted corrections remain exact in extraction/conversion/export/roundtrip. Normalization permitted only runtime copy with source/runtime sums/factors/hash evidence; trust is researcher-reviewed. First compare canonical cells with source/extraction, re-extract only if normalization established; ambiguity or sum=1 does not authorize restoration.

nodes.label: Regional Overview model selection ownership

Recommend when choice unauthorized, record actual authorized selection. FAIL/NOT_RUN may remain selected without repairs/annual validity. Every saved first/replacement/cleared selection completes central/web refresh unless explicitly deferred, even blocked; historical unselected reports remain dated.

nodes.rationale: Source recovery/extraction, constructor admission, reconstruction assumptions, diagnostics, taxonomy/catch coverage, geography, selection and annual readiness are independently reported. Candidate metadata patches use stable keys/current headers, one coordinator serializes central writes. Additional companion scientific fields remain purpose-specific evidence, not EwE-import claims.

nodes.rationale: Project.xlsx central metadata and regional Overview selection remain authorities; generated project tables do not receive raw taxa/catch/group coefficient matrices. Exact material availability and relocation alias identities supersede stale missing-file descriptors while historical retrieval counts stay history. Graph refresh uses existing tools/knowledge_graph with scope/hashes/endpoints/retrieval checks, not all binary inputs or historical status as current evidence.

nodes.label: Serialized keyed Project freshness updates
nodes.rationale: One coordinator rereads live workbook hash and keyed staged patches, preserving unrelated records and backups. Updater checks Project and supplied regional workbooks immediately before save and rejects intervening changes; reconcile new state rather than restore stale snapshot or rewrite hashes. Canonical discovery includes only regions/type/unit/unit.xlsx, not review appendix. All-region update replaces generated records/removes orphans without SPPR/matching.

Verify generated workbook and visible selected model/results/unavailable/diagnosis/time-series; remembered browser/URL state can override defaults, so update affected current choice while preserving unrelated preferences. Temporary exploratory dropdown is separate from Overview selection. Provisional coefficients need explicit exception and production false; mapping controls/classic subset may be available while Ecopath methods remain NOT_RUN.

nodes.label: Article overlay and scientific region geometry separation

Display land/tiles do not replace scientific boundary/calculation inputs. Read-only loopback map launcher is local, not deployment; tiles have attribution/fallback without repeated failures.

Relocation/cache cleanup does not change regional science or require rebuild. Newly adopted extraction updates regional NPP/provenance and dependent ratios before consolidation; retained versioned configuration/code/source evidence required, not ignored-runtime-only paths. Missing NPP never zero; frozen expansion not silently reused.

nodes.rationale: Anonymous cohort IDs avoid taxa in central Project. Paired ratios use common-catch totals, annual comparisons stable common region cohort with method catch coverage. Preserve blanks/zero-denominator absence/health/scopes/bases/unidentified treatments/carbon conversion; ranks use documented2019totalcatch reference, not current map display basis.

nodes.label: Source canonical and runtime identity separation
nodes.rationale: Numerical success at one layer does not prove fidelity at another. One distinct scientific variant has its own model ID and sole model.json, not source/loaded JSON companions. Compare source→eight imports→canonical→reconstructed fields, missing masks and identities.

nodes.label: Native group and sentinel crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Join continued tables by verified IDs, order, life stage and versions, not positions. Printed zero, blank, inequality, rounded zero and sentinel stay distinct. Complete fisheries, unit/area bases and multistanza equations require source review.

nodes.label: Authorized coupled biological reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Unknown B/PB/QB/EE may be solved only as an explicitly authorized variant with rank/uniqueness, residual, admissibility and independent checks. Loader B=1 is not biological reconstruction; underdetermination is not filled by tuning.

nodes.rationale: Record censored-to-zero, imputed B, rate/EE changes, derived BA, normalization and synthetic groups. BA closure does not demonstrate observed trends or source steady state. Use UTF-8 and compare names; Word fallback owns only its hidden read-only automation documents.

nodes.label: Variant normalization pooling discards and scenario provenance
nodes.rationale: Preserve existing authorization and source evidence. Pool compatible stocks/flows without averaging EE or inferring fate from habitat fractions. Discard ancestry, removal, recipient and external export are separate. Record exact persisted-input hashes/settings and bounded reload parity.
nodes.norm_label: variant normalization pooling discards and scenario provenance

nodes.label: Runtime-equivalence downstream refresh trigger
nodes.rationale: Canonical hash change alone does not require reruns. Compare actual runtime within 1e-12, excluding human-permitted BA, BA-rate/growth and predation changes while recording them separately. Equivalent state retains actual historical identities; other changed state refreshes affected outputs. Selection/signoff remain separate.

nodes.label: Independent extraction admission and readiness outcomes
nodes.rationale: Report source recovery, source admission, assumptions, diagnostics, taxonomy/catch coverage, spatial suitability, selection and numerical readiness separately. Retain unsupported published fields in evidence companions, never invent a successful blocked run.

Assumption-dependent coverage differs from newly gained coverage. 20260929 review is pair-specific, not universal lookup.

nodes.label: Confirmed-normalization-only re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Compare actual selected cells with retained source/conversion history. Sum1 proves neither normalization nor fidelity. Ambiguous evidence cannot overwrite; accepted researcher overrides remain, with actual decision/date/identity.

nodes.label: Runtime normalization on separate copy
nodes.rationale: Always permitted; trust review is not execution permission. Save raw/runtime sums/factors/cells/settings; normalization does not explain rounding/material deficits. No normalized data write-back or routing/unrelated edits.

nodes.label: Admissible source-runtime equivalence bridge
nodes.rationale: Retain historical input hashes; source byte change alone is not runtime change. Compare within1e-12 excluding permitted BA/growth/predation only. Removed proof source leaves numerical readiness pending. Do not overwrite old diagnostic hashes, selection or signoff; serialize shared updates.

nodes.label: Diet unknown-cell companion status
nodes.rationale: Standard diet schema stays unchanged; companions preserve status/source/correction/variant restrictions and known subtotal versus full missing sum.

nodes.label: Static Ecopath functional-group snapshot
nodes.rationale: Mass-balance snapshot over defined period/area is distinct from Ecosim dynamics/Ecospace spatial extension. Typical wet units do not override source carbon/dry/energy units.

nodes.label: Ecopath production master equation
nodes.rationale: B·PB = catch+predation+net emigration+BA+B·PB·(1−EE). EE=(Y+predation+E+BA)/(B·PB); steady PB=Z and rates differ from biomass flows. Missing migration/BA can legitimately explain residuals.

nodes.label: Ecopath group energy master equation
nodes.rationale: Q=P+R+GS·Q; R/B=QB(1−GS)−PB. Positive respiration requires P/Q<1−GS. Producers lack consumption/GS and detritus lacks production/respiration.

nodes.label: Ecopath three-of-four source parameters
nodes.rationale: Three of B/PB/QB/EE plus diet solve fourth jointly; systematic blanks and model-estimated markings stay. Two parameters prompt prose recovery; all four may combine input and output.

nodes.label: Published versus computed Ecopath outputs
nodes.rationale: TL, M2/M0/F, GE, net efficiency, respiration and network metrics may be reported outputs. Extract reported values without deriving to fill source gaps. Balance checks prompt investigation rather than changing legitimate author residuals.

nodes.label: Detritus and fleet fishery balance
nodes.rationale: Detritus receives other mortality/egestion/discards and loses consumption/export. Preserve multiple pools/routing; no guessed allocation. Fishery Y=L+D; unspecified total goes Landings with disclosure, never synthetic split.

nodes.label: Unverified remembered Ecopath formulation citations
nodes.rationale: Polovina, Christensen & Pauly1992 and Christensen & Walters2004 are remembered citations explicitly not database verified. Check before publication and confirm BA/E sign conventions.

nodes.label: Mortality discard fate and calculation boundaries
nodes.norm_label: mortality discard fate and calculation boundaries

nodes.label: M0 mortality rate versus calculator flow
nodes.rationale: Article M may include predation. model.M0=B·PB·(1−EE) is flow; divide by B for other-mortality rate. Bay shark example0.021024564 flow versus0.104082/year does not prove source natural-M discrepancy. Preserve EE and reconcile source/version/units.
nodes.norm_label: m0 mortality rate versus calculator flow

nodes.label: Full fleet removals and discard-return ledger
nodes.rationale: Retain fleets, L/D/total, assumptions, fate and offal transfers. Legacy export→catch alias is one sink; detritus catch cleared and source returns may be omitted by calculator. Count internal return once, preserve donor/consumers, no undocumented offal.

nodes.label: Frozen experimental discard boundary
nodes.rationale: Separate catch removal, M0 proxy, external sink and documented return. Frozen source/settings retained; experimental adapter changes equations, not production engine/extraction. Physical sink differs from evaluation catch vector; detritus residual is not a new annual fitted model.

nodes.rationale: Convergence can violate conservation/plausibility. Fixed-TL invariance does not prove zero uncertainty; four-model findings are model-specific and do not authorize coverage/scientific edits.
nodes.norm_label: separate source physical numerical and ecological validity

nodes.label: Derived temporary extraction directory identity
nodes.rationale: Writer uses native model_number/name/year, never list position; missing identity errors. Current converted model.json and latest imports permanent. ZIP only external delivery; use exact stdout path and absolute scripts.

nodes.label: Fixed EwE UTF-8 CRLF import schemas
nodes.rationale: No double-quote delimiters/commas/newlines in standard cells, literal headers/order/numbers preserved. Apostrophe writer permits but historical validator rejects: known unresolved tooling inconsistency; do not rename source or bypass checks. Companions allow ordinary CSV quoting.

nodes.label: Blank zero and authorized convention distinction
nodes.rationale: No derived P/Q/TL or repeated Z/PB unless source says. Blanks stay unknown/-9999, zeros only stated; explicitly authorized convention recorded separately. EwE defaults are potential import behavior, not author evidence.

nodes.rationale: Absolute or per-biomass supplied form preserved with precision; negative means declining stock, blank unknown and qualitative statement no number. Slopes carry source endpoints and arithmetic.

nodes.rationale: Current fixed-input identity: with positive B·PB and fixed catch/predation, negative BA lowers computed EE, positive BA raises it by BA/(B·PB). This does not authorize changing printed BA/EE. Recover only source-stated BA; unknown remains blank. Explaining an EE warning alone does not establish full extraction fidelity or balance.

nodes.label: Four scientific parameter provenance classes
nodes.rationale: Tabulated, prose-derived, model-estimated and convention-derived categories stay distinguishable. Unknown category is withheld, not relabeled source evidence.

nodes.rationale: pdftotext-layout can emit real numbers under wrong predator columns. pdfgrid groups word bboxes with PyMuPDF preferred/Poppler fallback and renders ragged mistakes visibly.

nodes.rationale: Resolve see-text pointers before extracting affected cells; parentheses/assumed/adjusted/inherited references alter provenance. Unresolved pointer is reported missing evidence, not filled.

nodes.label: Whole-chapter and targeted prose sweep
nodes.rationale: prose_sweep reports candidate passages, not automatic values. Read each in context, include discussion and re-search remaining blanks by group. Pointer hits persist even numbers-only.

nodes.label: Scoped prose numeric derivation
nodes.rationale: Identify groups, rate versus amount, measurement versus assumption and override. Assimilation complement, discard-of-catch versus discard-of-landings and model area arithmetic recorded. Entirely→1, qualitative mainly is not a numeric diet; partial proportions leave missing remainder.

nodes.rationale: Prefer structured table except footnote redirects cell; methods for assumptions and explicit later-specific revision. Retain both exact locators and choice, never average or choose better balance.

Rectangular unique headers or verbatim source_grid, safe filenames; manual changed omitted file prevents cleanup. Numeric and missing-mask tolerance absolute1e-12/relative1e-14, parameter_roles distinguish estimated inputs.

PDFs pages, spreadsheet hidden sheets/formulas, DOCX footnotes, code-derived values and OCR methods recorded.

nodes.rationale: Paper manifests/role index record bytes/context; native inputs provenance numerical use; portable source_paths only relocation. Unknown bibliography/access stays unknown. nodes.label: No automatic allocation fallback
nodes.rationale: Select evidence-backed candidates independently of coefficients. Direct caught mass then reviewed complete catch/biomass Medium, W11 explicitly Very low. No automatic equal split, normalization of bad sums or silent zero candidate removal; nearby donor confidence/SPPR don't copy.

nodes.label: Mapping coverage and numerical availability separation
nodes.rationale: Persist exact full-precision weighted rows; unresolved group/weight blank. Validate all taxa, duplicates/composites/nonnegative unit sums/basal errors/source contradictions and actual tonnage support. Structural success doesn't certify source/model approval; examples aren't assignment tables.
nodes.norm_label: mapping coverage and numerical availability separation

nodes.label: Earlier coarse-taxon coverage examples
nodes.rationale: Earlier unresolved snapshots Arabian21.8%, Bay22.3%, East China22.1% motivate attention to tonnage. These counts are historical, not current mapping readiness.

nodes.label: Coarse label candidate containment heuristics
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy/SAU habitat-size/commercial hints and model members constrain each plausible group, including dedicated plus residual compartments. Playbook's hard habitat/offshore exclusions are narrowed by current M10/M11 regional contract, not cross-region lookup tables.

nodes.label: Superseded coarse mapper automatic weight cascade
nodes.rationale: Retained playbook describes blank catch composition and automatic model-catch→biomass→equal with three-level confidence. Current regional/mapping/output contract overrides this: full numeric reviewed weights, Medium proxy assumptions, explicit W11 and five confidence levels; no automatic fallback.
nodes.norm_label: superseded coarse mapper automatic weight cascade

nodes.label: TL corroboration without guild selection
nodes.rationale: TL alone cannot assign guild; arbitrary broad group mixture just approximates average SPPR. Don't split a known single home merely to hide uncertainty.

nodes.label: Annual PPR NPP discard integration semantics
nodes.norm_label: annual ppr npp discard integration semantics

nodes.label: Final full-precision fixed regional mapping
nodes.rationale: Regional Matching authority includes exact weights/confidence/evidence; assumption ledger all zeros/rejections. Biological/spatial set precedes weight; weighted coefficient verified, fixed across years/scenarios.

nodes.label: Three taxon catch bases and single carbon conversion
nodes.rationale: C=L+D when all known; evaluate actual L/C/D×mapped SPPR/9 separately. Assumed wet:carbon9 retained, deferred literature review not implemented. Method/zero/simple unidentified treatments share catch basis; simple catch-taxon TL All-only differs from model TL benchmark. Unknown components/coefficients not0 and historic failure gates remain.
nodes.norm_label: three taxon catch bases and single carbon conversion

nodes.label: Current NPP sources and historical expansion distinction
nodes.rationale: Current annual instructions/source verifier/npp plan separate extraction from adoption. September counts frozen, scaled2019 distinction retained. Missing/error/partial statuses and n_models/source years preserved; earliest constant proxy only before first available, not canonical overwrite or CI.
nodes.norm_label: current npp sources and historical expansion distinction

nodes.label: Independent simple PPR and NPP-only identities
nodes.rationale: Catalog, selection and ecosystem sets distinct. Model-free All simple PPR/NPP can exist under absent/failed Ecopath; no-catch HS018/LME064 NPP without PPR. NPP-only curve independent of model/method/baseline; geometry display simplification not scientific integration.
nodes.norm_label: independent simple ppr and npp-only identities

nodes.label: atlas_lme_high_seas_union_v1 denominator
nodes.rationale: Fixed dissolved66LME/18HS including no-catch, noEEZ, coverage-limited not world ocean. Integrate each scheduled NPP algorithm before median, not sum regional medians; complete scheduled-model support distinct from regional available ensemble. Preserve window/water observed/fill/exclusions.

nodes.label: Uncached byte-hash scientific provenance and resume
nodes.rationale: Validate exact same-year parent/config/code/geometry/arrays/output identities; cached metadata/path/mtime or historical1104-file audit doesn't prove freshness. Changed identities create new cache. Preserve raw/code snapshot/staged bytes under scoped Git rules; one raster worker until memory review.
nodes.norm_label: uncached byte-hash scientific provenance and resume

nodes.label: Compatible group routing response transfer
nodes.rationale: Historical response file identity matches exact source/model/workbook/method/scope/groups/weighted baseline. f=D/(L+D) uniform source allocation is assumption. All same landed vector/weights, no support shrink; only allowed adjacent valid points, no extrapolation/missing bridge. Two compatible routes needed; source zero harvest unsupported.

nodes.label: Common named-route cohort sensitivity envelope
nodes.rationale: Sum same named routes across whole fixed cohort then min/max; never sum unrelated regional extrema/drop unsupported unit. Same selected NPP denominator; missing ratio can coexist valid carbon bounds. Frozen31 combinations and four-model limitations are snapshot evidence, not global band.

nodes.label: Coordinated atomic publication and scoped diagnostics
nodes.rationale: One exporter owner, no reader certifies replacing workbook; atomic artifacts excluded inventories and old complete artifact survives failure. Actual saved controls/download verification distinguished from handler test. Fresh direct methods, global/MC separate scope; no broad exporter just to fill evidence.
nodes.norm_label: coordinated atomic publication and scoped diagnostics

nodes.label: Model group taxonomy guild habitat stage and strata axes
nodes.rationale: Neighbour seas can have incompatible axes. Record actual source prefixes, stocks/pools/catchability and model-versus-target area before mapping; inherited examples remain examples.
nodes.norm_label: model group taxonomy guild habitat stage and strata axes

nodes.label: Taxonomic pool versus single stock
nodes.rationale: Dedicated names can hide restricted pool; source definitions and independent evidence govern, not generic name or catch share alone.

nodes.label: Feeding-guild model membership evidence
nodes.rationale: Retrieve source list/supplement and diet context; families may span dedicated and guild groups. Diet corroborates feeding, not exhaustive membership under current contract; TL alone cannot choose guild.

nodes.label: Spatial stratum allocation distinction
nodes.rationale: Bay numeric prefixes denote subareas/depth versus unprefixed whole domain; native example warns against all catch silently placed stratum2. Biomass/stage catch examples require current evidence hierarchy, not automatic assignment.

nodes.label: Nonliving and primary producer mapping restrictions
nodes.rationale: Detritus/import/PP catch assignment usually invalid, documented harvested seaweed exception. Verify actual fishery for plankton/benthic small groups; meaningful current analogues require explicit rationale, not default observed catch claim.
nodes.norm_label: nonliving and primary producer mapping restrictions

nodes.label: Adopted Matching versus proposal evidence
nodes.rationale: One exact model/taxon/group numeric full-precision row, fixed per distinct region-model pair. CSV proposals not alternate registry. No automatic catch-biomass-equal cascade or error-total normalization.

nodes.label: Membership allocation and assumption records
nodes.rationale: Weaker necessary five-level confidence with independent flags; direct composition High, source catch/B Medium, M10/M11/W11 Very low. Preserve genuine zero/rejected candidates; numeric availability doesn't prove membership.

nodes.label: Source membership table and group dictionary
nodes.rationale: Model-local extraction and validation evidence owners distinct. Printed versus verified names, exhaustive/illustrative/allocation/diet purpose, all unfished groups, exact keys and direct/supporting/inferred source relationships retained. Blank missing versus not documented completed search.
nodes.norm_label: source membership table and group dictionary

nodes.label: Checkable source-located mapping explanation
nodes.rationale: State explicit member/synonym or defined ecology/candidate/weight assumption. Inference is not publication prose; filename not coverage (OkhotskNE label not northeast proof). Old validator obsolete schema, use maintained checks and independent review.

nodes.label: Project.xlsx
nodes.rationale: Owns central publication/model metadata and explicit human reviews; generated regional summaries are replaced without inventing source metadata.

nodes.label: Regional workbook
nodes.rationale: Owns editable selection, independent catch/classic/NPP inputs and typed model-dependent outputs.

nodes.label: Workbook table contract
nodes.rationale: @table markers and keyed typed rows preserve multiple blocks per sheet; authoritative formulas are rejected to prevent stale cached values.

nodes.label: Registered researcher review
nodes.rationale: The actual signed source decision and model/input identities govern review display; changed sources require registration and drafts confer no adoption.

nodes.label: Existing model refresh
nodes.rationale: One regional refresh derives selection outputs, snapshots outgoing results by actual identity, restores compatible material and publishes ready or pending state.

nodes.label: Latest model extraction
nodes.rationale: Each distinct model retains one latest extraction and departures; Git supplies recovery without administrative scientific repair.

nodes.label: Canonical graph scope
nodes.rationale: The bounded index records corpus/freshness limits; an old indexed snapshot and graph retrieval cannot establish current science or researcher approval.

nodes.label: Direct and report diagnostic scopes
nodes.rationale: Direct defaults retain GE, TE and With Egestion; report rows retain GE/TE. Broader inventory/Monte Carlo needs its own authorization.

nodes.label: Read-only saved table inspection
nodes.rationale: A named table plus source hash explains saved state without assessing whole-workbook readiness.

nodes.label: Content-checked in-memory read session
nodes.rationale: Repeated coherent-operation reads may reuse parsing while mutation/publication guards remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Provisional research preview
nodes.rationale: Explicit authorized display retains finite failed contributions and flags while excluding reviewed common-catch comparison; it creates no missing coefficients or scientific validity.

nodes.label: Atlas region rank
nodes.rationale: Ranks use 2019 simple-chain all-source total catch with status ok within the curated set; equal values share rank and unavailable/nonmembers remain blank.

nodes.label: Common-catch cohorts
nodes.rationale: Anonymous cohort IDs avoid repeating identical common-support series centrally; the underlying taxa remain regional.

nodes.label: Calculation freshness and ownership
nodes.rationale: Changed numerical inputs invalidate fingerprints and require compatible recalculation; selected JSON changes require reviewed SPPR evidence rather than rewritten hashes.

nodes.label: Researcher exclusions in displayed PPR
nodes.rationale: Approved exclusions affect displayed contributions only and retain original allocation weights without redistributing omitted shares.

nodes.label: PPR/NPP carbon conversion
nodes.rationale: PPR numerator is divided by nine once; unsupported NPP years remain blank.

nodes.label: Shared operation router
nodes.rationale: Simple routes narrow mandatory reads while composed routes retain the union of applicable full procedures.

nodes.label: Bounded workbook read mechanics
nodes.rationale: Optional sheets and an operation-local deep-copy cache reduce repeated parsing while retaining default complete-reader semantics and same-mtime content detection.

nodes.label: Frozen comparison criteria
nodes.rationale: Freeze exact identities/masks/manual content and numeric tolerance before comparison; do not relax failed comparisons or confuse package timestamps with typed values.

nodes.label: Blind source extraction
nodes.rationale: Original-input extraction must finish before retained answers are revealed so independent work remains distinguishable from reuse.

nodes.label: Observed matched overhead
nodes.rationale: Matched actual reads/parses/calls/writes/checks and wall time support efficiency claims; static routing tests and instruction length alone do not.

nodes.label: Classified trial evidence
nodes.rationale: The capture records independently extracted, saved-evidence, regenerated and partial work separately; coefficient/source mismatches prevent a full pipeline equivalence claim.

nodes.label: Retained scientific limitations
nodes.rationale: Decimal-sentinel/apostrophe defects, construction restrictions, unknown execution identity, unavailable sources and pending results remain explicit and authorize no repairs.

nodes.label: Single mapping stage ruling
nodes.rationale: The user requires one shared mapping decision stage across both skills, with validation checking exact keyed evidence and affected gaps returned to that stage.

nodes.label: Researcher-accepted scientific parameter preservation
nodes.rationale: Accepted manual scientific inputs stay protected; mapping authorization does not authorize restoration of publication parameters, diet normalization or rebalancing.

nodes.label: Full validation scientific universe
nodes.rationale: Routing scopes reads without reducing complete catch taxa, GE/TE negative pairings, mapping/confidence, geography/time, denominator and all-page QA.

nodes.label: Validation authorization boundary
nodes.rationale: Ordinary review authorizes evidence/report arithmetic and reports, while fresh scientific execution needs existing explicit scope; independent work finishes before any dependent approval request.

nodes.label: Signed review adoption
nodes.rationale: Validated and disqualified signed decisions may be registered within authorized scope; rejection retains exact reason/date and preserves selection/results.

nodes.label: Continuing file exclusions
nodes.rationale: Exclusions precede reading, hashing, copying and rendering; a named exception does not lift unrelated exclusions.

nodes.label: Model-local validation outputs
nodes.rationale: Each exact model owns the report, appendix and evidence beside its canonical input/departure notes, preserving snapshots and independent authored data.

nodes.label: Exact model year and basis
nodes.rationale: Resolve selection/reference year/basis or explicitly named candidate without choosing an unselected model or changing Overview.

nodes.label: Evidence identity and freshness
nodes.rationale: Match model/group/period/scope/method/settings/provenance before reuse; an existing validation bundle is not proof of freshness.

nodes.label: GE and TE source-column negative contribution review
nodes.rationale: Every negative source column and affected retained group is reviewed for GE and TE, including unfished groups; a positive total can conceal negative contributions.
nodes.norm_label: ge and te source-column negative contribution review

nodes.label: Complete catch-taxon audit
nodes.rationale: One exact keyed audit row for every catch taxon includes zero rows and High/Medium decisions; duplicate identifiers are checked before aggregation.

nodes.label: Membership and allocation confidence
nodes.rationale: Membership and weight rules are assessed separately and the weaker necessary component sets overall confidence; unresolved weights remain unknown and proposals unadopted.

nodes.label: Independent simple-chain confidence coverage summary
nodes.rationale: Catch and independent classic simple-chain PPR use the same taxon rows and complete denominators; zero catch contributes zero even with missing coefficients, while positive missing-coefficient catch is unknown.

nodes.label: Linked mapping appendix
nodes.rationale: The seven-column appendix uses the same audit rows, descending unrounded simple-chain PPR, unavailable values last, and a descriptive Sources sheet.

nodes.label: Component rule coverage summaries
nodes.rationale: Membership and allocation rule tables separately account for the same complete known-PPR universe and cannot be added; Very low taxa appear once with exact reasons.

nodes.label: Two-denominator geographic overlap assessment
nodes.rationale: Report overlap as a share of both target region and model study area, with evidence-backed approximations and period differences; image scales cannot substitute for area measurements.

nodes.label: Pending alignment and authorized adoption gate
nodes.rationale: Final report decisions must match adopted regional/map data; discrepancies remain keyed pending-alignment drafts until adoption/publication is authorized.
nodes.norm_label: pending alignment and authorized adoption gate

nodes.label: Complete report and appendix verification
nodes.rationale: Verify arithmetic, exact negative source/group pairings, appendix order/units/links/manual entries and every rendered report page plus the spreadsheet before delivery.

nodes.label: Single mapping handoff consumption
nodes.rationale: Full validation checks the one mapping stage's keyed evidence; conflicting or absent decisions return to that stage and leave dependent alignment pending.

nodes.label: Selection loadability readiness and researcher approval separation
nodes.rationale: Selection, loadability, construction, readiness and approval are distinct; scientific execution/adoption follows existing exact authorization and proposals remain proposals.
nodes.norm_label: selection loadability readiness and researcher approval separation

nodes.label: Stage-specific evidence handoff
nodes.rationale: Only actual scientific stages create their applicable evidence inventory; definitions, wording edits and review metadata synchronization do not create a complete pipeline inventory.

nodes.label: Scientific identity missingness and status preservation
nodes.rationale: Canonical input, departures and ephemeral loaded state stay distinct; exact IDs, missingness, uncertainty, diagnostic restrictions and researcher edits are protected.
nodes.norm_label: scientific identity missingness and status preservation

nodes.label: Content identity and publication guards
nodes.rationale: Compatible saved reuse uses dependency checks and mutable-input rechecks while central serialization, rollback and stale-page gates remain authoritative.

nodes.label: Route before detailed reading
nodes.rationale: Record the exact target, existing authorization/exclusions and operation first; composed tasks read the union without waiving full-route scientific requirements.

nodes.label: Explain saved field route
nodes.rationale: A named saved definition/table answer checks applicable identity/missingness/status without generating artifacts or claiming readiness.

nodes.label: Named wording and layout route
nodes.rationale: Bounded edits preserve unrelated manual/scientific content and render every output page; changed assertions use their affected evidence route.

nodes.label: Researcher review sync route
nodes.rationale: Actual signed source and exact page identities flow through existing read/register/refresh APIs with rollback and central serialization; stale pages stop dependent work.

nodes.label: Existing model selection route
nodes.rationale: One existing regional refresh preserves snapshots and independent inputs; unknown historical identity blocks numerical reuse without inventing provenance.

nodes.label: Regional arithmetic route
nodes.rationale: Recalculate compatible retained coefficients and affected outputs; missing coefficients or new taxa require explicit unavailable state or targeted science.

nodes.label: Targeted mapping route
nodes.rationale: Review/adopt only named affected decisions within authority; confidence-only work proves groups/weights unchanged.

nodes.label: Full model validation route
nodes.rationale: Full validation retains the complete scientific universe, matrices, denominator checks, appendix and all-page render with unavailable evidence explicit.

nodes.label: Model extraction route
nodes.rationale: Extract requested model/period from original bytes with exact masks, imports, round trips and departures; loadability is separate from construction/results.

nodes.label: Direct diagnostics route
nodes.rationale: Authorized full GE/TE/With Egestion returns preserve matrix axes/masks/status and effective settings; exceptions/timeouts do not count as successful methods.

nodes.label: Full pipeline route
nodes.rationale: Finish every authorized applicable stage and distinguish independently completed, reused/regenerated and incomplete work.

nodes.label: One mapping stage per pipeline run
nodes.rationale: Pipeline and validation combine membership/weight/confidence/evidence requirements before resolving each exact model-region taxon decision once, avoiding duplicate research and conflicting assignment passes.
nodes.norm_label: one mapping stage per pipeline run

nodes.label: Keyed mapping evidence handoff
nodes.rationale: Pass current Matching rows or an authorized proposal with content hashes, model/region identity, exact groups/weights/confidence/reasons and unresolved status as provenance, not approval/configuration.

nodes.label: Validation of shared mapping decisions
nodes.rationale: Validation verifies and reports the exact existing rows for appendix, rule summaries and denominators without repeating established taxonomy/group/allocation work.

nodes.label: Revisit only affected mapping decisions
nodes.rationale: Dependency/evidence/conflict gaps return only affected taxa to the same stage within authorization; independent audits remain separately labeled and proposals are not silently merged.

nodes.label: Dependency-scoped reuse
nodes.rationale: Notes, confidence, mapping, model/flags/code, catch, NPP and relocation affect different dependents; reuse requires the actual relevant input identities.

nodes.label: Current content-hash freshness
nodes.rationale: Current content/dependency hashes supersede timestamps and cached manifests; mutable input rechecks preserve status/uncertainty/review restrictions and never rewrite fingerprints to bypass gates.

nodes.label: Scoped workbook evidence reads
nodes.rationale: Named-table inspection and selected-sheet reads return scoped evidence; complete default reading still checks all authoritative tables/formulas.

nodes.label: Operation-local read session
nodes.rationale: An in-memory session validates full hashes on reuse, reparses changed bytes, and returns copies; new contexts reacquire evidence and it confers no readiness or approval.

nodes.label: Mixed-version publication rejection
nodes.rationale: A changed consumed input rejects publication for the mixed session even after rereading; begin a new coherent session and retain transaction guards.

nodes.label: Serialized mutation and rollback authority
nodes.rationale: Project.xlsx writes are serialized and rollback snapshots remain until acceptance checks; bounded failure does not authorize broad build or administrative repair.

nodes.label: Truthful stage completion
nodes.rationale: Original-input independent extraction, reuse, regeneration and incomplete stages are reported separately; partial trials are not full pipeline replication.

nodes.label: Matched efficiency measurement
nodes.rationale: Actual matched traces count required/unique/repeated reads, parses, engine/render calls, writes/checks and elapsed time, with cold/reuse and unavailable-token labels.

nodes.label: Regional SPPR matching PPR and NPP contract
nodes.norm_label: regional sppr matching ppr and npp contract

nodes.label: Matching row contract
nodes.rationale: Source membership precedes analogues; exact model group IDs and numeric resolved weights sum to one, while unresolved group/weight fields remain blank.

nodes.label: Transparent near-complete mapping coverage
nodes.rationale: Meaningful disclosed approximations can improve catch coverage without changing focal model taxonomy or establishing scientific validity.

nodes.label: Component confidence hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Overall confidence is the weaker membership/allocation component in High, Medium, Low, Very low, Unresolved order; a one-group analogue can retain High allocation and Very low membership.

nodes.label: W10 source geographic allocation
nodes.rationale: High allocation requires applicable measured caught-mass quantities across exact model compartments, not visual/range overlap.

nodes.label: Catch then biomass allocation hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Complete source-supported model catch precedes complete biomass at Medium confidence; loader-filled absent rows are unknown, never genuine zero evidence.

nodes.label: W11 expert numerical allocation
nodes.rationale: A justified last-resort rule, including explicit equal-share assumptions, may resolve allocations at Very low confidence while retaining candidates and raw values.

nodes.label: Genuinely unresolved mapping
nodes.rationale: Unresolved is reserved for no meaningful candidate, contradiction of every candidate or no justifiable numeric allocation; missing coefficients remain a separate limit.

nodes.label: Source taxonomy and mapping assumptions
nodes.rationale: taxon_descr stays faithful to publication membership while broad assumptions, confidence and reasons reside in the regional review ledger.

nodes.label: Evidence-supported nearby-model mapping fallback
nodes.rationale: Focal mapping may transfer donor evidence through an explicit compatible group crosswalk and receiving confidence assessment; proximity alone justifies neither High membership nor donor weights/SPPR adoption.

nodes.label: Size-stage allocation and extrapolation
nodes.rationale: Search regional caught-mass composition before proxies, record assumptions and reuse one model-region mapping across retained years/bases with fixed-weight extrapolation explicit.

nodes.label: Authorized regional arithmetic
nodes.rationale: The calculate stage validates assignments, remaps coefficients and records annual freshness; inspect-year changes only the taxon table view.

nodes.label: Sensitivity bound invalidation
nodes.rationale: Changed-input recalculation invalidates inherited bounds until scientifically reassessed.

nodes.label: Group inventory without coefficients
nodes.rationale: Exact accepted JSON group inventory can support mapping despite blocked SPPR, preserving missing coefficients and NOT_RUN/exception limits.

nodes.label: Annual NPP and carbon units
nodes.rationale: NPP is annual carbon; missing years stay missing, atlas-union denominators remain distinct, and wet-equivalent PPR converts by nine once.

nodes.label: NPP originals extraction and adoption
nodes.rationale: Global originals and source manifests are preserved, extraction planning precedes authorized runs, and new values require a separate reviewed workbook/provenance update.

nodes.label: Portable retained scientific provenance
nodes.rationale: Before adoption retain source/configuration/executed-code evidence at permanent versioned ownership with portable links; ignored runtime outputs do not provide permanent provenance.

nodes.label: Unidentified simple availability scope
nodes.rationale: No-decomposition unavailability applies only to unidentified=simple in PP/inner; exact verified scoped coefficients can recover contaminated derived rows without lifting genuine diagnostic restrictions.

nodes.label: Scientific stages and protected project behavior
nodes.norm_label: scientific stages and protected project behavior

nodes.label: Source canonical and loaded state separation
nodes.rationale: Unknown source values stay missing and transformations/defaults/solved values require evidence; exact group membership links extraction to catch mapping.
nodes.norm_label: source canonical and loaded state separation

nodes.label: Selection-dependent publication
nodes.rationale: Saved selection changes publish dependent central/map/trend/source defaults within their existing scope while preserving FAIL/NOT_RUN and independent inputs.

nodes.label: Confidence-only numerical preservation
nodes.rationale: Evidence-backed confidence changes inspect all requested taxa and preserve numerical assignments, separating eligibility from stage/weight/model-applicability uncertainty.

nodes.label: Documented nearby-model mapping transfer
nodes.rationale: Donor evidence and compatible definitions justify assessed transfers; nearby location cannot copy group IDs, allocation weights or SPPR automatically.

nodes.label: Portable evidence links
nodes.rationale: Local report/appendix/evidence links resolve relative to the containing file while external URLs/internal anchors survive clone/download relocation.

nodes.label: Parser-consumed Word edit compatibility
nodes.rationale: When headings/labels feed the signoff parser, compare identity/date/sections/source references before and after; identical parts/links/rendering do not prove registration compatibility. Unexpected summary changes block adoption as keyed gaps and do not authorize parser repair or source-decision rewriting.
